definition: KnowRob (Knowledge processing for robots) is a system which combines knowledge representation and reasoning methods to acquire and ground knowledge.
details: This system is the backbone of openEASE. both under developing at the Institute for Artificial Intelligence at the University of Bremen, Germany.
story: Imagine a mathematician who writes every step on paper, reads it back, crosses out a bad line, and starts that line over. Slowing down to think often beats answering fast. Instead of blurting out an answer, the machine talks its way through the problem one step at a time. More time spent reconsidering can be worth more than a bigger model. And that habit of thinking twice — or a hundred times — is Knowledge processing for robots.
